findings.note: Heuristic false positive: 'task get' body performs c.Post() to DataForSEO task_get endpoints AND UPDATEs the local task_ledger (status, fetched_at, result). Both an external POST and a local DB write. mcp:read-only would mis-classify a write-shaped operation and let agents skip the destructive-action prompt incorrectly.
